# Photovoltaic Plant (PhysicsPV)

> **Class**: `PhysicsPV` | **Module**: `energysim.models.renewables` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Simple Solar Photovoltaic system model.

DC power is linear in plane-of-array irradiance, derated linearly with cell
temperature (NOCT cell-temperature model with a wind-speed damping term);
the inverter is a generic efficiency-vs-load curve with a hard AC clipping
limit and an optional curtailment setpoint. It is *not* a single-diode,
five-parameter or Sandia array/inverter model, and there is no spectral,
angle-of-incidence, soiling or shading loss.

Validity: G_poa in 0-1300 W/m2, T_amb -20..50 C, v_wind 0..20 m/s; the
output is a smooth surrogate for plant-level studies, not for bankable yield.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'SolarPV'` | - | - |
| `p_dc_stc_mw` | `float` | `1.0` | MW | DC array rated peak power at Standard Test Conditions (STC: 1000 W/m2, 25 C) in MW. |
| `inverter_p_ac_max_mw` | `float` | `0.9` | MW | AC inverter maximum rated capacity in MW. |
| `temp_coeff_p` | `float` | `-0.0038` | - | Power temperature coefficient in 1/K (default -0.38 %/C for crystalline silicon). |
| `noct_c` | `float` | `45.0` | degC | Nominal Operating Cell Temperature in C (at 800 W/m2, 20 C ambient, 1 m/s wind). |
| `inverter_curve` | `Optional[Curve1D]` | `None` | - | Inverter efficiency vs normalized DC power. |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |

| `T_amb` | degC | - |

| `curtail_limit` | MW | - |

## Validity and notes

*No validity range is documented for this model yet.*

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import PhysicsPV

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('physicspv', model=PhysicsPV(), outputs=['P_ac', 'P_dc', 'T_cell'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['physicspv'].tail(2))
```
